mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises > 0.5pp in 2 months, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing RSAFS (a proxy for reduced supply chain pressures) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in interaction-driven periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive decline in GDP (GDPC1) indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 30% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL inflation rises > 3% YoY, and FEDFUNDS is above 2%, it signals a hawkish monetary stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between decreasing RSAFS and increasing INDPRO predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 35% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.018 over any 1.5-year rolling window during recovery regimes.
